title: Share QRegularExpression across all rule instances
message:
Share QRegularExpression across all rule instances

Some regexes are complex and appear multiple times within a syntax.
Sharing them prevents them from being compiled multiple times and
allows for future options in the `skipOffset` section of `highlightLine`.

title: groups all the rules into a single container to eliminate the shared_ptr<Rule>
message:
groups all the rules into a single container to eliminate the shared_ptr<Rule>

`shared_ptr<Rule>` was used because ownership is shared among the contexts that use them.

By placing all the rules in a single list, there is now only one owner,
and the contexts can use raw pointers.

title: Zsh: fix subscript and variable substring
message:
Zsh: fix subscript and variable substring

```zsh
echo ${str: i}
 # Before:  ^ Normal Text
 # Now:     ^ Variable (arithmetic context), because space before

echo        $a[(r)patt]
 # Before:     ~ ~      Glob
 #              ~       Pattern
 #                ~~~~  Normal Text
 # Now:        ~~~      Parameter Expansion
 #                ~~~~  Pattern

echo        $a[-1-1]
 # Before:     ~~~~  Number
 # Now:        ~~ ~  Number
 #               ~   Operator
```

title: RTF: Fix unbounded context stack growth
message:
RTF: Fix unbounded context stack growth

Return from the temporary backslash and parameter contexts using #pop instead of pushing a new context_normal instance.

The previous transitions left the completed contexts on the stack for every RTF control word. This caused the highlighting state to grow throughout the document, resulting in excessive memory usage and increasingly slow highlighting for large RTF files.
